---
name: New skill proposal
about: Propose a new topic or a new skill for this library
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: proposal
---

## Proposed topic

Short name and number (if it extends the 111; otherwise, what scope does it open?).

## Problem statement

What real production problem does this solve? Who hits it?

## Evidence it isn't covered

Checklist of nearby existing topics and why they don't suffice (attach links).

## Outline

Definition, when to use, internal working, 1–2 implementation bullets, one failure scenario, one AI/LLM relevance note.

## Who would maintain it?

You? Team?

## Prior art

Links to talks/posts/papers that show demand.
